levels.surface: عامر بن سعد بن أبي وقاص

notes: «- وهو ابن إسماعيل -» is an editor's gloss on «حاتم» and is left out
«كتبت إلى جابر بن سمرة» makes Amir the asker, who is already a link; Jabir is the one asked and answers in writing («فكتب إلى»), so he is the next and the last link
Several sayings of Jabir («وسمعته يقول») repeat the same chain, with no new transmitter: one group, no saying labels
«مع غلامي نافع» names the messenger, who is not a link
